title: Update GitHub prompts, copilot instructions, and AI agent configurations

subtasks.content: Read existing unit tests (`vscode-extension/src/test/unit/parser.test.ts`, `fuzzy-match.test.ts`, `script-values.test.ts`) to extract Mocha/assert patterns for use as replacement examples

Delete `.github/skills/pytest-testing-patterns` and create `.github/skills/mocha-testing-patterns` with TypeScript/Mocha testing patterns (describe/it/assert, beforeEach, parametric, CLI commands) derived from existing unit tests

Update `.github/copilot-instructions.md` to remove Python 3.9+ prerequisite (line 124) and the entire 'Python Requirements' section (lines 131-170); remove Python folder structure references; ensure TypeScript-only content throughout
Audit `kanban-development-guideline.md` for vestigial Python section; remove if found, confirm TypeScript-only content
Audit `.claude/settings.local.json` for `Bash(pytest:*)`, `Bash(python:*)`, and `test_paradox_checks.py` entries; remove if found; validate resulting JSON
Remove Python 3.9+ references, pytest patterns, pygls documentation references, and pip-based setup instructions from `.github/placeholder`

Rewrite `.github/prompts/LSP Feature Implementation.prompt.md` to replace pygls `@server.feature()` decorator patterns, `from pygls.server import LanguageServer` examples, and pytest fixture/async test patterns with TypeScript LSP provider patterns and Mocha tests

Rewrite `.github/prompts/Adding New CK3 Language Features.prompt.md` to replace Python language definitions, completion/hover providers, validation logic, and @pytest.mark test examples with TypeScript equivalents

Rewrite `.github/prompts/architecture_and_flow.md` to replace Python module paths (`pychivalry/`, `server.py`, `parser.py`), pygls architecture, and `pygls.readthedocs.io` link with TypeScript server subsystem paths and current data flow

Update `.github/prompts/Version Update Assistant.prompt.md` to remove `pyproject.toml` update procedures, `python -m build`, `pip install`, and `python -c` version checks; replace with `package.json` version workflow
Update `.github/prompts/documentation_standard.md` to replace `from pygls.server import LanguageServer` example and Python docstring standards with TSDoc/TypeScript documentation conventions
Update `.github/prompts/Branch Merge Assistant.prompt.md` to replace `pytest tests/ -v`, `flake8 pychivalry/`, `mypy pychivalry/` with `npm run test:unit`, `npm run lint`, `npm run format-check`
Update `.github/prompts/gh pr review.prompt.md` to replace `pytest tests/` commands with `npm test` / `task test:unit`
Update `.github/prompts/gh run view.prompt.md` to replace any Python-specific test job logging references with TypeScript/Mocha equivalents
Verify `.github/prompts/Test Writing Best Practices.prompt.md` contains no Python/pytest references; update if any vestiges found
Rewrite `.github/skills/ck3-validation-debugging` to replace all Python validator examples (`pychivalry.parser`, `pychivalry.scopes`, etc.) with TypeScript test patterns using actual project imports

Update `.github/skills/lsp-feature-debugging` to replace `pychivalry.parser.CK3Parser` usage, pytest `@pytest.mark.asyncio` tests, and `cProfile`/`pstats` profiling with TypeScript debugging patterns and Mocha tests

Rewrite `.github/skills/lsp-performance-optimization` to replace Python profiling tools (`cProfile`, `memory_profiler`, `line_profiler`, `psutil`), `asyncio` patterns, and `pytest-benchmark` with Node.js profiling and Mocha performance tests
Update `.github/skills/vscode-extension-workflow` to remove `python -m pychivalry --version` command reference
Remove the Python Environment Management tools section and Pylance/Python Analysis (MCP) section from `.github/skills/tool-list.md`
Update `.github/prompts/README.md` to replace any descriptions referencing pytest patterns with TypeScript/Mocha descriptions; remove mentions of 'Python files'
Audit all 13 agent definition files under `.github/agents/` for any Python/pytest/pygls references
Run `grep -ri` across `.github/`, `kanban-development-guideline.md`, and `.claude/` for pytest, pyproject, pygls, flake8, mypy, hypothesis, and 'python 3.9' to verify zero remaining Python references
Verify `kanban-development-guideline.md` and `.github/copilot-instructions.md` are consistent with each other after all edits
